text:
Priya: kicking off Citrine Health onboarding. short thread to align owners, 30d plan, success gates, and renewal risks. cc @Ben @Aisha.

Ben: context: Citrine wants Dedicated for convo triage + embeddings. POC in prod-like infra within 30d. main asks: consistent latency + audit logs.

Aisha: customer stakes: Sara (PM), Mark (eng), Leo (security), Tanya (support). need tech kickoff + security review.

Devon: proposed 30d flow: Day0 intro/access; Days1-4 provisioning; Days5-11 integration & staging runs; Days12-19 perf tuning; Days20-30 final signoff & go-live.

Carlos: customer success criteria:
1) availability >=99.5% in go-live window
2) p95 gen latency <300ms for 512 tokens
3) audit logs delivered to their S3/KMS
4) beta NPS >=8 (10-20 testers)

Priya: top risks & mitigations:
- latency spikes -> canary routing + fallback model (Devon)
- compliance delays on key rotation/HSM -> security deep-dive (Aisha)
- cost overruns -> Optimize recommendations + autoscale caps (Carlos)

Ben: owners? tech/devon; security/aisha; cost/carlos; CSM/priya.

Priya: actions: Devon share staging checklist + load script EOD; Aisha schedule 30m security review with Leo tomorrow; Carlos share 90d cost projection; Ben coordinate 15m exec intro.

Devon: checklist snippet:
- VPC peering
- token auth + rotation test
- 50 concurrent sessions @128 tokens
- collect OTEL traces + Redwood latency logs
Linking k6 run after tests.

Aisha: will draft key-rotation/HSM note and loop infra-security.

Carlos: will run Optimize on sample prompts after Devon posts baseline metrics. first pass tomorrow.

Ben: will build a 6-question pulse survey for pilot (NPS, latency perception, false positives, config friction, docs clarity, overall).

OnboardingBot: Ticket RB-4821 created -> infra assigned, ETA 48h.

Devon: blocked pending Citrine VPC CIDR + service account; Sara to provide by EOD.

Priya: target: pilot report by day21; gating decision by day18. owners update thread with progress; flag go/no-go issues asap. :thumbsup:
